headline: Backend engineer focused on services, reliability, and delivery safety
summary: Backend engineer working across service design, release automation, and operational reliability. Strong in API design, queue-backed workflows, and the tooling around safe delivery. Most effective when translating infrastructure concerns into repeatable developer workflows.

selectedProjects.title: Service Gateway
bullets: Designed a queue-backed API gateway that isolated bursty internal jobs from synchronous request paths.
Improved release safety by adding health checks and staged rollout controls to service deployment scripts.
